ROOT CAUSE 2026-10-12 (second pass, read from production after #3383 deployed). A repeat anonymous view with the whole cookie jar retained was still MISS with private, no-store, while /events/<slug> answered PRERENDER with a public cache-control, and the build table marks /market/[id], /store/[id], /housing/[id] and /classifieds/[id] as dynamic. The difference is generateStaticParams: Next 16's generate-static-params.md says a dynamic route revalidates (ISR) at runtime only when generateStaticParams exists (an empty list is enough), and those four pages were the only sitemap-advertised details without one. Each now exports generateStaticParams returning [], so every path is generated on its first visit and cached; lib/nav/public-detail-isr.test.ts and the LIVE-884 probe require it on every ISR-intended public detail. The capture script now retains the whole cookie jar between the first and repeat view.

Closed 2026-10-12. Root cause was Next 16 needing generateStaticParams for revalidate to take effect on a dynamic segment (#3384), after the service-listing session read was removed (#3383). Production evidence captured 2026-10-12T16:17Z from a Vercel sandbox: anonymous first view MISS (the proxy sets the discovery stamp), repeat view with the cookie jar retained HIT with public cache-control and no Set-Cookie, malformed and archived ids 404. scripts/evidence/public-market-detail.json, bound to the source digest.
